meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 面对 git 任务时,Claude 先查看仓库现状并判断任务属于提交、整理提交历史、查询历史还是查看状态;提交时会把改动按意义分批提交并沿用仓库的提交信息习惯,查询历史时给出对应命令和证据,改写历史前先做安全检查。
howto.when: 当你要求提交改动、压缩或整理提交、询问某次改动的来源/原因等 git 历史问题时触发;仅普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 帮我把改动分成几个有意义的小提交,提交信息沿用仓库里的写法。
say.note: 它只暂存你指定的部分,其余未提交改动不受影响。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压成一个,保留主要信息。
say.note: 会用自动整理的方式完成压缩,不碰你没提过的分支。

say.text: 查一下 report.md 第21行是谁在哪个提交里改的。
say.note: 运行 git blame,给出提交哈希和改动上下文。

howto.what_en: Claude inspects git state, classifies requests as commit, rewrite, history, or status, makes atomic commits in the repo's message style, answers history questions with command evidence, and checks safety before rewriting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to make a commit, squash/reorder/rewrite commits, or investigate a git-history question. Not used for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split working changes into atomic commits; mirror the repo's commit-message style.
say_en.note: Only requested parts are staged; other dirty files stay untouched.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one, keeping the main message.
say_en.note: Uses autosquash; does not touch unnamed branches.

say_en.text: Find which commit changed line 21 of report.md and show the evidence.
say_en.note: Runs git blame with commit hash and context.
